name: Screening cleared — notify operator
description: Fires when a sanctions/PEP screening returns CLEAR. Surfaces a notification to the compliance officer so the case can move into approval.

action.subject: Screening cleared for case {{.case_id}}
action.body_template: Case {{.case_id}} ({{.holder_name}}) has cleared sanctions and PEP screening. Ready for compliance review.

name: Settlement complete — email client
description: Confirms to the client that a deposit/withdrawal has been ledger-posted and externally settled.

action.subject: Your transaction {{.reference}} has settled
action.body_template: Hi {{.holder_name}}, your {{.direction}} of {{.processed_amount}} {{.currency}} (ref {{.reference}}) has settled. View the receipt in your portal.

name: KYC approved — activate wallets
description: When a Simple-KYC case completes with approved outcome, signal the client's account grain to activate the default wallet set.

name: High-value transaction — require four-eyes review
description: Gate any transaction whose USD-equivalent exceeds USD 50,000. Routes the case to the executive queue for a second approver.

name: Account opened — post opening journal
description: On successful account opening, post the zero-balance opening entry against the operator's correspondent ledger so the new account shows up on the books.
